result.short_description: P1 - Fraud engine false positive spike after model update
result.description: Fraud scoring engine reporting 18% false positive rate (target: <2%) after model v2 deployment on 2026-09-27. Legitimate transactions being flagged as fraudulent, causing customer payment declines. Issue began approximately 2 hours after CHG0090401 deployment. Affected services: mfs-fraud-engine running on mfs-fraud-pod-01 and mfs-fraud-pod-02 in mfs-prod namespace. Model serving via svc-fraud-engine service account. Root cause suspected: feature drift in real-time extraction not matching training data distribution.
result.resolution_notes: Root cause: Feature extraction pipeline (FRD-102) was computing merchant_risk_score using a stale reference table that had not been refreshed with latest merchant category codes. The model v2 was trained on refreshed data but served against stale features, causing score distribution mismatch. Fix: Refreshed merchant_risk reference table in mfs_fraud_db and added automated staleness check to feature pipeline startup. False positive rate returned to 1.4% within 30 minutes of fix.

result.short_description: P2 - Transaction monitor Kafka consumer lag
result.description: Transaction monitoring Kafka consumer group 'mfs-txn-monitor-cg' experiencing sustained lag of 45,000+ messages on 'mfs.txn.enriched' topic. Velocity window calculations are delayed by 3-5 minutes, meaning real-time alerts are not truly real-time. Consumer running on mfs-txn-mon-pod-01 under svc-txn-monitor. Issue started after partition count increased from 12 to 24 during planned scaling.

result.short_description: Deploy KYC document verification service to production
result.description: Deploy the KYC document verification service to production including OCR extraction pipeline, document authenticity checks, and Tesseract integration. Deployment to mfs-kyc-pod-01 in mfs-prod namespace under svc-kyc-engine service account. Database writes to document_verifications table in mfs_customers_db on pghost-prod-03.mfs.internal.
result.implementation_plan:
1. Deploy svc-kyc-engine v1.0 to mfs-kyc-pod-01 in mfs-prod namespace
2. Run database migration for document_verifications table on pghost-prod-03.mfs.internal
3. Configure Tesseract OCR engine with language packs
4. Verify OCR extraction accuracy against test document set
5. Enable traffic routing from KYC onboarding flow (FRD-401)
result.backout_plan:
1. Scale down mfs-kyc-pod-01 replicas to 0
2. Revert database migration on pghost-prod-03.mfs.internal
3. Re-route KYC onboarding to manual verification queue
4. Notify Identity & Compliance team of rollback
result.test_plan:
1. Execute test cases TC-FRD-008 and TC-FRD-009 against staging environment
2. Verify OCR extraction accuracy for passport, driver's license, and national ID
3. Validate document_verifications table writes on staging DB
4. Confirm svc-kyc-engine health checks pass on mfs-kyc-pod-01

result.short_description: ML model false positive rate spike after Q3 retraining
